name: web-marquee-of-avatar-name-pills-in-three-offset-rows-with-fade-edges
title: 'Trusted By The Best People' with three rows of avatar-and-name capsules staggered and fading at the edges over a faint diagonal texture
whatItIs: A white page with a bold centred heading and three horizontal rows of white capsules, each holding a round photo avatar with a bold name and grey role, the rows offset from each other and fading out at both sides, over a pale hatch texture.
whatItMeans: Soft and populous; staggered capsules suggest a crowd of real people.
techniques: Keep names bold and roles grey.

vocabulary.definition: A pill with a photo, name and role.
